name: oliver_caption
_note: Alex Q&A SF caption look (Oliver house style, per the official Visual Guide). = caption-clips spice_1080 with: y=48% center (under chin), default weight = Medium / highlights = Black, guest=#FED90F / alex=#FFFFFF (v2 spec 2026-07-06), numbers auto-Black. Color+italic per-word is set by qa_build's EDL director (guest => yellow+italic, alex => white upright). fonts_dir resolves against the caption-clips skill (where generate_spice.py lives).

timing._note: v2 spec Part 2 (2026-07-06): min_cue_dur 0.21s = the 5-frame ABSOLUTE floor (sequential layout: a crammed cue PUSHES the next, nothing dropped; dense cues get a +1-frame reading bump in generate_spice). onset_correct = hold a caption through a pause Groq folded into the next FUNCTION word. pause_split_s defaults to 0.25 (>=250ms silence = break) in generate_spice.
